create_TestConsumer: create a TestConsumer instance to record and track stream consumption calls for testing
test_consume_values: test consuming values by calling consume on TestConsumer and inspecting the calls history
test_terminate_stream: test terminating a stream by calling terminate on TestConsumer and verifying the calls list
test_consume_and_terminate: test consuming a final value and terminating in one step using consume_and_terminate
review_is_legal: review the is_legal method to validate that stream calls follow a legal sequence
